newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-HEYNCKES SIGNS FOR REAL MADRID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HEYNCKES SIGNS FOR REAL MADRID.

text.p: German coach Jupp Heynckes signed a two-year contract with newly-crowned Spanish champions Real Madrid on Tuesday, replacing Fabio Capello who has returned to AC Milan.

Heynckes, formerly at Athletic Bilbao, took unfancied Tenerife to the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup this season and his record has impressed Real president Lorenzo Sanz who said he would give more details of the signing when Heynckes was officially presented on Wednesday.
Sanz also said that the club was interested in signing Real Betis central defender Roberto Rios as a replacement for Rafael Alkorta, who is moving to Athletic Bilbao.
Betis would have to be paid two billion pesetas ($13.8 million) to make Rios a free agent, according to a term in the player's contract.
In other news Atletico Madrid coach Radomir Antic has signed a new contract which will keep him at the Vicente Calderon stadium until the end of next season.
Antic took Atletico to the league and cup double a year ago but this season they could only manage fifth place in the league.
